goal: Prove that the Phase 57M workflow controls behave deterministically before any actual candidate evidence packet enters review.
publication_rule: Publish only conformance-test, validation-harness, and receipt-template controls; preserve all nine outcome holds and keep every synthetic result outside the evidence ledger.
authority_rule: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN workflow controls, reviewer receipts, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.evidence_stage: Amtrak conformance, validation, and receipt controls
records.title: Amtrak passes 24 accepted-label conformance tests
records.finding: Every accepted Amtrak adapter label matches after case normalization and outer-whitespace trim only, without supplying or transforming a source value.
records.denominator: 24 accepted-label tests across 12 fields and 2 contracts; zero failures.
evidence_limits: A passing label test is not source evidence.
Label acceptance cannot supply or validate a field value.
No semantic aliasing or inner-whitespace transformation is allowed.
records.next_action: Apply the same exact-match rule to one cited candidate packet under named human review.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN workflow controls, reviewer receipts, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.evidence_stage: Amtrak conformance, validation, and receipt controls
records.title: Amtrak returns 12 ambiguous labels for clarification
records.finding: One deliberately ambiguous label per Amtrak field is rejected without coercion and routed to clarification.
records.denominator: 12 ambiguity tests, 12 clarification routes, and zero coerced labels.
evidence_limits: Synthetic ambiguity tests are not observed source labels.
A clarification route does not infer the intended field.
Rejected labels cannot carry values into another field or record.
records.next_action: Require the reviewer to cite the exact source label before field-level evaluation continues.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN workflow controls, reviewer receipts, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.evidence_stage: Amtrak conformance, validation, and receipt controls
records.title: Amtrak fixture harness passes 4 bounded packet validations
records.finding: Every empty and deliberately incomplete Amtrak fixture reaches its expected reject, clarification, privacy, authority, or period route.
records.denominator: 4 synthetic fixture executions and zero actual candidate packets or evidence records.
evidence_limits: Fixture execution is not evidence ingestion.
A passing harness does not establish that an official candidate packet exists.
No fixture can reach acceptance, trigger, closure, or publication.
records.next_action: Keep the validator output outside the evidence ledger and attach it only as workflow audit metadata.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN workflow controls, reviewer receipts, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.evidence_stage: Amtrak conformance, validation, and receipt controls
records.title: Amtrak defines 12 machine-readable reviewer-receipt templates
records.finding: Every Amtrak decision row now has a receipt template for reviewer identity, reason code, cited source, decision time, escalation state, and publication-review handoff.
records.denominator: 12 templates across 2 contracts; zero actual reviewer identities, receipts, or handoffs.
evidence_limits: A template cannot create a reviewer identity or decision.
Receipt fields remain empty until an actual cited packet receives human review.
Accept still routes only to a separate publication review.
records.next_action: Require a complete receipt before any actual review decision can advance to publication review.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN workflow controls, reviewer receipts, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.
